basis: DXL’s fiscal Q3 2023 earnings release first established the threshold. Its consolidated statements of operations report sales of $119,188,000 for the three months ended October 28, 2023, versus $129,671,000 for the three months ended October 29, 2022. Sales fell 8.1% and were $3,999,450 below the $123,187,450 cutoff. The earlier Q3 outlook covered comparable sales only.

coverage.detail: May 25, Q1 release. Management said sales were trending toward the lower end of its previously issued outlook for the 53-week fiscal year. It gave no Q3 consolidated sales range.

May 25, public Q1 call, checked via transcript. Management expected difficult sales trends through Q2 and a return to positive comparable sales in the second half. Neither statement bounded Q3 total sales.

August 24, Q2 release. The $535 million to $545 million sales forecast covered fiscal 2023. Subtracting six-month actual sales of $265.485 million implies $269.515 million to $279.515 million for Q3 and Q4 combined. The release’s mid-single-digit decline applied to comparable sales in the first few weeks of Q3.

August 24, public Q2 call, checked via transcript. The CEO quantified the first three weeks’ comparable-sales decline at 6.5%. The CFO forecast a mid-single-digit Q3 comparable-sales decline. Neither figure established a full-quarter consolidated revenue ceiling.

Between the August 24 and November 17 releases, DXL’s archive lists a September 30 Queens store opening, an October 2 UNTUCKit collection announcement, and an October 20 earnings-date notice. The archive and searches for interim presentations, conference remarks, and preliminary results yielded no Q3 consolidated sales update.
October 20. DXL announced the November 17 results date and 9 a.m. Eastern webcast without disclosing preliminary sales.
November 7 Form 8-K. Item 5.02 and Exhibit 10.1 concerned the amended annual incentive plan approved November 2. They supplied no Q3 sales figure.
November 17, Exhibit 99.1. The earnings release’s consolidated Sales row gives 119,188 and 129,671 in thousands for the respective quarters.
The Q3 Form 10-Q confirms the same reporting perimeter. Wholesale sales were zero in both quarters, and store plus direct sales reconcile to each consolidated total.

publication_date_evidence: DXL’s investor-relations results page timestamps the public release November 17, 2023 at 7:00 AM EST. The release dateline and SEC Exhibit 99.1 independently identify November 17.
